description: Audit of every Python computation script under folio-assistant/computations/ for alignment with the paper's 3-input canonical scheme (calibration-inputs.md): q_0 from m_μ/m_e, m_e, and Q_β(n). Flags scripts that use both m_p AND m_n from CODATA (over-counts hadronic input), use Vol_hyp (fitted under option B), or omit canonical input modules entirely.

caveats: Heuristic detection by import + regex. False positives possible for scripts that comment out CODATA constants or use them only for comparison rather than derivation.
Per calibration-inputs.md: m_n = m_p + Q_β (Hecke engine). Scripts using both m_p and m_n from CODATA are using 4 hadronic inputs where 3 suffice.
